name: exploratory
description: Create data, charts, analytics, and reports in Exploratory Desktop v17 or later.

ai_summary.title: AI Summary output
ai_summary.description: Whether to create and save an AI Summary for charts and analytics you create

save_comments.title: Save comments
save_comments.description: Whether to save an explanatory comment on charts you create

review_hook.title: Review hook
review_hook.description: false: never review. true: review after creating: check custom R steps (exp_custom) that start in the wrong form or that product commands can do, ask the agent to review its work (before the first chart or analytics create, after wrangling, after a note is created, after chart and analytics create or edit calls, up to 8 per session), and ask once to look at the whole note or each dashboard page image before the final report.
